verses.html: A Song of degrees of David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.text: A Song of degrees of David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.title: A Song of degrees of David.
verses.titleHtml: A Song of degrees of David.

verses.html: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.text: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.html: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.html: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.html: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.html: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.text: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.html: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.html: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
verses.text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
